legal_change.finding: The city of oblast significance Polysaevo was transformed to a city of district significance and administratively subordinated to the city of oblast significance Leninsk-Kuznetsky. The amended register entry names Polysaevo and subordinate settlements Krasnogorsky and Shakhta No. 5.

findings.interpretation: The 2017 feature label does not establish a current separate city-of-oblast-significance unit. Law 18-OZ is an administrative-territorial change, distinct from Law 46-OZ's 2024 municipal merger.
